answer: Random jury draws with tenure gating: each epoch a public seed picks graders, and only identities with a long record of passing answers are eligible. A sybil farm can't choose which juries it lands on, so to swing one verdict it must keep hundreds of clones honest for months, each posting a slashable bond. Even a whisper of lockstep scoring against the majority gets flagged, and slashing spreads like a reef through every wallet funded from one source. By the time a fake reaches its zenith of influence, it has cost more than it can earn.
